name: update_malpractice_coverage
description: update_malpractice_coverage: Update the malpractice insurance details for a provider. If the new per-occurrence limit is below $1,000,000, the system automatically flags the record for re-credentialing and opens a review case. Returns a case_id.

new_carrier.description: The new malpractice insurance carrier. Match the caller's spoken carrier name to the closest value (e.g. 'ProAssurance' → proassurance, 'The Doctors Company' → the_doctors_company, 'MAG Mutual' → mag_mutual). Record the lowercase form exactly.

new_policy_number.description: The new policy number. Format: POL-YYYY-XXXXXX (POL, dash, 4-digit year, dash, 6 alphanumeric characters). This is the new policy being filed, not the existing policy on record. Example: POL-2025-BK4420

per_occurrence_limit_usd.description: Per-occurrence coverage limit in whole USD. Example: 1000000 for one million dollars

aggregate_limit_usd.description: Aggregate coverage limit in whole USD. Example: 3000000 for three million dollars

effective_date.description: New policy effective date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-07-01

expiration_date.description: New policy expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2027-07-01
